agent.name: Emerging Technology Adoption Agent
agent.specialty: contextual adoption recommendation for an emerging technology application (Fortino Ch. 8 four zones and adoption decision instrument): one of adopt, bounded experiment, proof of concept, monitor, defer, reject for now, with decisive factors and change conditions

analytical_question: Should the hypothetical retailer use text-to-image diffusion for internal campaign concepts now, and what preparation and evidence gathering can proceed without executing a tool?
general_et_finding: UNIT: Text-to-image diffusion models, with latent diffusion as the reference architecture. PARENT: Generative AI for image synthesis. MATURITY ZONE: Bleeding edge. ZONE BASIS: No qualifying independent repeated-use share or two independently checkable routine-use organizations specifically attributable to this unit were verified in this search. This is the framework's evidence default, not a claim of technical infancy. DIFFUSION EVIDENCE: Independent — Artificial Analysis's 2025 survey reports production deployment among 44% of 78 organizational image-generation respondents; the broader image-generation category lacks diffusion-specific attribution, so this cannot set the unit's zone. MESSAGING SHIFT: Observed — Stability AI's April 8, 2026 Brand Studio announcement emphasizes creative workflows and a named agency partnership rather than novelty; vendor social proof remains insufficient crossing evidence. RELATIVE ADVANTAGE: Claimed — commercial workflow benefits are reported, but independently measured comparative benefits specifically attributable to diffusion were not verified. KEY UNCERTAINTY: Whether generation plus selection and correction produces dependable net gains over existing image-creation methods — Testable.
application_finding: APPLICATION ZONE: Bleeding edge. ZONE BASIS: ArcTouch, May 7, 2024 — Checkable organization-authored mood-board project account, but experimental and without verified diffusion attribution; does not qualify as routine use. Huge, April 8, 2026 — Vendor-only partnership account, without sufficient evidence of routine internal concept-board use. Neither counts toward the two-case threshold. No qualifying application-specific repeated-use share was verified. The application matches the general evidence-default zone; neither level has verified crossing evidence. FIT: Partial — visual ideation matches image synthesis, but product fidelity and usable direction still require human curation. BEST ALTERNATIVE: Catalogue-reference mood boards assembled manually with professional design support. ADVANTAGE OVER ALTERNATIVE: Marginal — additional visual directions are plausible, but net time, cost and decision-quality gains remain unmeasured.
organization_specific_finding: UNIT OF ANALYSIS: The retailer's owner deciding whether two marketing staff should execute an image-generation tool for internal campaign concepts now. ORG POSTURE: Conservative adopter — the case explicitly requires demonstrated comparable-peer results before authorizing a trial. SCOPING CONDITIONS: (1) Keep generated concepts internal, clearly marked as synthetic references, with no publication or substitution for separately checked final photography and copy. (2) Before any execution or upload, obtain owner authorization and check the selected model/version's license, input rights, retention and permitted-use conditions. (3) Require human catalogue comparison and exclude unsupported brand references before a concept influences a campaign brief. CONSEQUENCE: Reversible — no explicit High/Moderate/Low level is supplied; scoped concepts can be discarded and customer exposure is excluded. DEPARTURE: None. BLOCKER: None — no external, configuration-independent prohibition is established. Unselected terms and internal authorization are unresolved preconditions, not evidence that responsible use is impossible under every configuration. GATES: Passed — FIT is Partial; ADVANTAGE OVER ALTERNATIVE is Marginal; BLOCKER is None. TABLE INPUT: Bleeding edge × Conservative adopter → Monitor. MODIFIER: not applied — consequence is Reversible. RECOMMENDATION: Monitor. During the six-week horizon, staff may gather checkable peer evidence, document the manual-process baseline and prepare a proposed comparison protocol without tool execution. This does not authorize a trial or establish organizational readiness.

evidence.claim: Latent diffusion performs image synthesis in a pretrained autoencoder's latent space and supports text conditioning through cross-attention.
evidence.source_or_reference: Rombach et al., High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models, https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.10752
evidence.notes: Supports architecture and technical capability; does not establish commercial adoption or independent workflow advantage.

evidence.claim: Stable Diffusion's public release made weights, code and demonstration access available.
evidence.source_or_reference: Stability AI, Stable Diffusion Public Release, https://stability.ai/news-updates/stable-diffusion-public-release
evidence.notes: Vendor release. Availability and historical license language do not establish current permission, repeated use or a maturity crossing.

evidence.claim: A 2025 survey reports production use among 44% of 78 organizational image-generation respondents.
evidence.source_or_reference: Artificial Analysis, State of Generative Media Survey Report 2025, https://artificialanalysis.ai/media/survey-2025
evidence.notes: Independent broader-category signal; selected respondent population and no diffusion-specific production denominator. Excluded from qualifying zone shares.

evidence.claim: Stability AI markets brand-specific production workflows and names Huge as a partner.
evidence.notes: Vendor-only social proof supports the messaging observation; partnership does not prove routine application use or independently measured gains.

evidence.claim: ArcTouch describes experimenting with AI-generated mood boards and applying the approach to its website redesign.
evidence.source_or_reference: ArcTouch, How designers can use AI to help generate mood boards, https://arctouch.com/blog/ai-design-mood-boards
evidence.notes: Organization-authored, independently checkable account. It does not establish repeated beyond-pilot diffusion use, so it does not satisfy the crossing rule.

evidence.claim: The supplied broad-sector and creator surveys cannot determine diffusion adoption for internal concept boards.
evidence.source_or_reference: Packet source cards D3, U.S. Census Bureau, https://www.census.gov/library/stories/2026/05/ai-use-businesses.html; D4, Adobe/Harris, https://news.adobe.com/news/2025/10/adobe-max-2025-creators-survey
evidence.date_or_recency: D3 published May 26, 2026; D4 published October 28, 2025. Cards supplied in the packet; these pages were not independently reopened in this run.
evidence.notes: Scope assessment based on supplied cards. D3 measures all AI; D4 is vendor-sponsored and spans creative generative AI. Neither provides the required unit-specific denominator.

evidence.claim: The case's conservative posture and reversible internal scope produce Monitor under the supplied decision table.
evidence.source_or_reference: Attached case assumptions and specialist decision procedure, applying the supplied Fortino Chapter 8 framework.
evidence.notes: Hypothetical management judgment, not measured organizational performance. No experiment, authorization, selected configuration or current legal clearance is established.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: ADVOCATE CASE: Proof of concept — a short non-production feasibility test could cheaply assess whether an already trained model produces usable visual directions, given reversible internal outputs.

RISK OFFICER CASE: Defer — execution should wait until owner authorization and selected input-use conditions are checked. However, these unresolved conditions do not establish the external, unsatisfiable blocker required for Defer.

BIAS CHECK: Excessive conservatism — treating missing matched-peer evidence as proof that the technology lacks value could prolong waiting. Preparing the baseline and seeking specific evidence limits that bias without overriding the stated posture.

DISTINGUISHING EVIDENCE: By December 15, 2026, obtain dated, checkable comparable-peer accounts documenting repeated internal campaign-board use over the preceding three months, net effort including corrections, and review incidents; separately obtain an explicit owner decision on trial authorization.

Searches were conducted in this run; source-card receipt alone was not treated as verification. Search coverage is limited and absence of qualifying evidence is not proof of absence of routine adoption.

Broader AI-image adoption and production figures cannot be attributed automatically to diffusion architectures. Coding-agent survey examples in the instructions are not relevant denominators for this technology.
No current license, input-use clearance or compliant configuration has been verified. This gap prevents an execution authorization but does not establish that no acceptable configuration exists.
confidence_and_uncertainty: RECOMMENDATION CONFIDENCE: Moderate — Monitor follows the explicit conservative posture and evidence-default application zone, but wider source coverage could change the zone. ZONE CONFIDENCE: General: Low — a qualifying diffusion-specific independent repeated-use share or two checkable routine organizational cases would change the classification. Application: Low — two checkable organizations routinely using diffusion for internal concept imagery or mood boards would change it. No current configuration or local value result is established.
value_opportunity_implication: Potential value is faster exploration of visual directions before commissioning photography. Savings must include prompting, selection, correction, catalogue checking and owner review. Record current staff minutes, designer cost, revision rounds and approved directions per brief now. These are proposed baseline measures, not observed benefits; concept images do not create a new revenue model in this case.
risk_governance_implication: Keep synthetic concepts internal and distinct from product representations. Before future execution, resolve selected-model terms and input rights, define permitted uploads and retention, and retain human review. Planning and evidence collection can start now. Tool execution remains outside this recommendation. Whether staff can sustain the required controls belongs to the Organizational Adoption Agent.
recommendation_management_implication: RECOMMENDATION: Monitor — no tool execution now. Through December 15, 2026, the two marketing staff may collect comparable-peer evidence, document the manual baseline and prepare a proposed matched-brief comparison. Measure net staff time, total cost, revision rounds and owner-rated concept usefulness. The owner maintains the no-execution boundary and reviews findings at the six-week endpoint; preparation ends without an automatic trial. DECISIVE FACTORS: [Application] No verified crossing evidence establishes Leading edge for this task class. [Organization] Conservative adopter posture sets the Monitor table cell. [Organization] Reversible internal scope does not activate the Severe modifier. DRIVING FACTOR: [Organization] The stated conservative posture applied to the evidence-default application zone.
change_monitoring_triggers: TRIGGER [maturity]: By December 15, 2026, verify two independently checkable organizations routinely using text-to-image diffusion for internal concept imagery or mood boards, with execution preconditions satisfied → Bounded experiment.

TRIGGER [internal capability]: By December 15, 2026, the owner explicitly changes posture to Fast follower, authorizes a non-production technical test, and selected input-use conditions are checked while the application remains Bleeding edge → Proof of concept.
TRIGGER [regulation]: At the December 15, 2026 review, verified dated external requirements establish that no available configuration can support this scoped use responsibly → Defer.

TRIGGER [new evidence]: By December 15, 2026, credible task-matched comparisons establish no advantage over manually assembled reference boards after full correction and review effort → Reject for now.

REVERSAL CONDITION: Verified routine-use evidence sufficient to move the application to Leading edge, with execution preconditions cleared, is the most direct route from Monitor to Bounded experiment.
REVIEW DATE: December 15, 2026 — six weeks after this assessment; no deployment date or market-stage transition is forecast.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: HANDOFF → Organizational Adoption Agent: Who will own authorization, review, upload controls and stop authority, and can the two-person team sustain those responsibilities?
HANDOFF → Landscape Agent: Which already trained configurations meet the proposed input, retention, license and internal-use conditions? Verify current terms without assuming a selected vendor.

HANDOFF → Diffusion Agent: Can you verify a diffusion-specific repeated-use denominator or independently checkable routine concept-board cases, separating broad image-generation adoption from this unit?
No abstention from the recommendation is required because the application and organizational posture are explicit. Tool execution is not authorized by this assessment.
